title_format.explanation: The title uses a lowercase type, optional scope/!, and ': '.

title_meaningful.explanation: The title names a concrete, intelligible change.

title_diff_consistency.explanation: The title agrees with the reference change and patch.

description_present.explanation: The description contains substantive change information.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The body explains the problem but omits the actual edits.

description_title_consistency.explanation: There is no concrete implementation account to compare.

description_commit_consistency.explanation: There is no concrete implementation account to compare.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: There is no concrete implementation account to compare.

limitations.explanation: The body defers assessment instead of naming concrete risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: No public field or configuration entrypoint is removed in this family; any behavior changes and scope risks are still documented in the reference text.

testing.explanation: No relevant checks or validation plan are described.

change_triviality.explanation: Only a misspelled relative documentation link is corrected.

text_diff_triviality.title_explanation: The stated work repairs a documentation link. Title: docs: correct the getting started link
text_diff_triviality.body_explanation: The body provides motivation and generic scope statements without describing actual edits.
